title: SkillHorizon: Constructing Long-Horizon Agent Tasks through Skill Composition
abstract: arXiv:2610.14966v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon agents must complete workflows in which later activities depend on earlier outputs and changes to shared state. A key challenge for evaluation is to expand task requirements and their dependencies while keeping tasks executable and outcomes verifiable. We introduce SkillHorizon, a benchmark that constructs long-horizon tasks through skill composition in seven business environments. Its generators use domain-specific rules to turn reusable skill procedures into concrete business activities. These activities are connected through input-output dependencies, shared resources, and state updates, allowing workload and coordination demands to grow together. Successful reference executions validate task feasibility and measure interaction workload, while programmatic evaluators assess local completion and whole-task success. We evaluate five language models on 1,050 tasks with reference interaction workloads ranging from 64K to 1M t

translated_title: SkillHorizon：通过技能组合构建长程智能体任务
translated_abstract: 长程智能体必须完成这样的工作流程：后续活动依赖于先前的输出以及共享状态的变化。评估面临的一个关键挑战是，在保持任务可执行且结果可验证的同时，扩展任务要求及其依赖关系。我们提出了SkillHorizon，这是一个通过技能组合在七个商业环境中构建长程任务的基准。其生成器使用领域特定规则，将可复用的技能程序转化为具体的商业活动。这些活动通过输入-输出依赖、共享资源和状态更新相互连接，使工作负载和协调需求能够同步增长。成功的参考执行用于验证任务可行性并衡量交互工作负载，而程序化评估器则评估局部完成情况和整体任务成功与否。我们在1,050个任务上对五个语言模型进行了评估，这些任务的参考交互工作负载从64K到1M token不等。
tldr: SkillHorizon是一个通过技能组合在七个商业环境中构建长程智能体任务的基准，其通过输入-输出依赖、共享资源和状态更新连接各项活动，使工作负载与协调需求同步增长，并保证任务可执行、结果可验证，在1,050个任务上评估了五个语言模型。
en_tdlr: SkillHorizon is a benchmark that constructs long-horizon agent tasks through skill composition across seven business environments, connecting activities via input-output dependencies, shared resources, and state updates so that workload and coordination demands grow together while tasks remain executable and outcomes verifiable, and it evaluates five language models on 1,050 tasks.
